mapper.select: SELECT * FROM afv_canvas WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_canvas(id, title, project_id, owner_type, owner_id, created_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{projectId}, #{ownerType}, #{ownerId}, #{userId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM afv_project p WHERE p.id = #{projectId} AND p.deleted = FALSE AND ( (p.owner_type = 1 AND p.owner_id = #{userId}) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM afv_project_member pm WHERE pm.project_id = p.id AND pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.deleted = FALSE AND pm.role IN (1, 2)) OR ( p.owner_type = 2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM afv_team_member tm WHERE tm.team_id = p.owner_id AND tm.user_id = #{userId} AND tm.deleted = FALSE AND tm.status = 1 AND tm.role IN (1, 2))))
